review_type: Second source-checked model/engineering audit, not expert gold annotation

labels.reason: Primary p00043 gives a 50-μL PCR1, 5-μL withdrawal, 7-μL treated continuation and no reported fate for the unsampled remainder. Explicit disposal is unsupported, rather than experimentally disproven.
Primary p00007 and p00041 explicitly specify a six-nucleotide capture UMI for this plate-RNA route. Eight nucleotides contradict that version; the older MAT 4-nt dependency is inapplicable.
Primary p00048 explicitly assigns the cell barcode and capture UMI to read 1, and the inner/outer primer, spatial barcode and oligo UMI to read 2. Reversing these assignments contradicts the source.

Expanded visible context p00007, p00018, p00019, p00041, p00042 and p00043 supports the shown local State claims and pooling/SPRI handoff. Removing partitioning and its Flows leaves an unmet explicit coverage requirement, without making the remaining pooling experimentally false.

pre_freeze_corrections: Excluded the ambiguous actual-candidate dsRNA wording from scored controls: possible shorthand for RNA-derived products is not an unequivocally contradicted polymer claim. Preserve the terminology clarification separately.
Expanded the positive local-coverage source context to cover UMI, ERCC, MPO and IVT claims present in the projected States.
limits: Four positive/negative pairs are small hand-selected regression sentinels, not calibrated accuracy or full-graph production-review sensitivity.
Local coverage requirement is supplied explicitly; this does not test whether a model discovers every missing requirement from the whole paper.
Paired values share context; identifying their differences is easier than independently auditing a whole graph.
No outcome depends on reconstruction of original protocol or experimental success.
No original Workflow output or frozen sources were edited.
